notes: Captured in Phase 0 (was permission-bash.txt; it is the external-directory read prompt). Buttons, not digits. Focus starts on 'Allow once' every time the dialog mounts, so Enter allows once. 'Allow always' opens a second 'Always allow' stage (Confirm / Cancel, Confirm focused), so it needs Right, Enter, Enter. esc rejects whatever the focus. Verified: Right+Enter stopped at the confirm stage; Right+Enter+Enter allowed always; esc rejected.
